big_picture.title: Stock Market Rally Fails As Dow Tumbles 1,101 Points; Anthropic's IPO Leaves AI Trade Cold
big_picture.excerpt: Dow components drop 1,101 points while Nasdaq's rally attempt fails on the first day of Anthropic's trading in Thursday's stock market.
paragraphs: Broad and fierce selling marked Thursday's action on Wall Street after a highly anticipated trading debut from Anthropic (ANT) failed to perk up the flailing artificial intelligence trade.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average ended 1,101 points lower, and losses on the other major indexes were steep as well. Blue chips collectively fell 2.2%, with the 30-member index undercutting the 50,000 level for the first time since June. Thursday's slide was the worst since Nov. 5 and marked the Dow's fourth straight decline.
